descriptionChirho: A large rock formation, cliff face, or rocky crag as a literal geological feature, including as a place of refuge, hiding, or landmark.
Metaphorical use of 'rock' as a title for God denoting refuge, strength, and security, typically with possessive suffixes ('my rock,' 'his rock').
Plural form referring to rocky cliffs, crags, or rugged rock formations as terrain features, often as places of concealment or inaccessible refuges.
The Edomite fortress-city Sela (later Petra), used as a proper place name derived from the common noun for rock.
